page_title: HAV 3-1 LYO | Le Havre v Lyon 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Gael Angoula has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adryelson (Lyon) replaces Rayan Cherki.
90+1' Looks like Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) is coming onto the pitch as Loic Nego cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Oussama Targhalline will be replaced by Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre).
85' It is time for a substitution. Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) is on for Josue Casimir.
83' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) will take the corner.
81' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon.
81' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' The free kick is taken by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon). His low shot to the middle of the net is denied by the keeper without any problems.
78' Lyon have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
77' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
75' The attendance is 23146.
74' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
70' That will be all from Ainsley Maitland-Niles who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Malick Fofana (Lyon).
70' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replacing Emmanuel Sabbi.
70' It's time for a substitution. Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) comes on in place of Daler Kuzyaev.
69' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
66' The ratio of the ball possession is 43:57.

62' 3 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Christopher Operi (Le Havre) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Anthony Lopes just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:1.
60' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
59' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.
54' 2 - 1 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Rayan Cherki inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the middle of the goal. 2:1.

50' 2 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 2:0. Anthony Lopes was helpless.
50' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
45+6' The ball goes out for a corner. Lyon can continue in their attacking effort.
45+6' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
45+6' A cross, provided by Rayan Cherki (Lyon), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.
45+5' Clinton Mata (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
42' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
38' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Le Havre will take a throw-in.
36' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes a short corner kick.
33' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Anthony Lopes.
32' The substitution has been made. Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) has replaced Diego Moreira.
30' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Gael Angoula had no choice but to send Jake O'Brien (Lyon) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

30' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jake O'Brien (Lyon), but referee Gael Angoula must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
28' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
24' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) commits a foul and Gael Angoula immediately signals a free kick.
20' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' The game is interrupted now, Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

18' 1 - 0 Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
18' Le Havre will take a corner kick.

17' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Anthony Lopes!
13' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' A rebound sits up perfectly for Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
9' Lyon enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Le Havre was in an offside position.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Gael Angoula.
